notes: Proved in Axeyum via `declare_prime_dvd_of_dvd_pow` (`nat_prelude/primes.rs`), by induction on the exponent `n`. `n = 0`: `pow m 0 = 1` (`pow_zero`), and a prime cannot divide `1` (`refute_dvd_one_against_prime`, the same `le_of_dvd`/`le_trans`/`le_of_succ_le_succ`/`not_succ_le_zero` route `prime_dvd_iff_not_coprime`'s `mp` branch already uses), so the hypothesis is vacuous. `n = succ j`: `pow m (succ j) = mul (pow m j) m` (`pow_succ`), and `euclid_lemma` splits `dvd p (mul (pow m j) m)` into `dvd p (pow m j) or dvd p m` -- the first branch applies the induction hypothesis, the second is the goal. formal.statement is Lean surface syntax accepted as a proposition by the proof-free generated axiom module; it is not kernel-core render_lean output. depends_on projects only direct upstream theorem uses whose endpoints both survived review.
